policy.scope: XperimentalHamid/XH Tales long-form novels, 1000+ chapter target
policy.importRule: Only titles independently verified as completed and with continuous source chapter coverage are eligible for full-text ingest.
policy.rightsRule: Full-text ingest requires republishing/sublicensing rights for the underlying novel/translation, not only permission to crawl the hosting site.

verifiedComplete.title: Billionaire God of War
verifiedComplete.notes: Independent novel index reports completed/fully translated through chapter 2495. XH master index contains the same long-form run.

verifiedComplete.title: Take My Breath Away
verifiedComplete.notes: Independent indexes mark the novel completed; XH source reaches the ending chapters through 1476. Some external catalogs include a 1477 thank-you note rather than another story chapter.

needsMappingBeforeImport.title: Nothing to Give But My Heart
needsMappingBeforeImport.reason: Do not import until 1682-1688 are reconciled or confirmed as extras/alternate numbering.

needsMappingBeforeImport.title: Punished by His Love
needsMappingBeforeImport.reason: XH page itself says updates were suspended/moved under another title. Need the complete XH/Tales replacement index before ingest.

needsMappingBeforeImport.title: A Dish Best Served Cold
needsMappingBeforeImport.reason: XH segmentation differs materially from independent completed catalogs. Need a one-to-one source mapping before ingest to avoid duplicates or missing text.

needsMappingBeforeImport.title: My Love Enlighten Me
needsMappingBeforeImport.reason: Different public catalogs appear to use the same/similar English title for different works. Verify original title/author and final count first.

excludedOngoing.title: A Man Like None Other
excludedOngoing.reason: Currently ongoing; source continues publishing new chapters.

excludedOngoing.title: Millionaire Son in Law / The Amazing Son in Law
excludedOngoing.reason: Source explicitly states latest chapters are still being written/published.

excludedOngoing.title: Reverend Insanity
excludedOngoing.reason: Not a completed novel; publication stopped before a canonical ending.
